chapter_title: Improving a Resource with AI Agents
learning_objective: The learner will apply the license rules to eight planned improvements and decide whether each plan is allowed as planned or not allowed as planned, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt.
specification:
Type: microsim **sim-id:** derivative-permission-checker
**Library:** p5.js
**Status:** Specified
**Bloom Level:** Apply
**Bloom Verb:** apply
**Learning Objective:** The learner will apply the license rules to eight planned improvements and decide whether each plan is allowed as planned or not allowed as planned, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt. **Prerequisites:** Derivative Work, and the license elements of Chapter 2 (BY, SA, NC, ND, and CC0) (all defined in this chapter above this block or in Chapter 2). **Evidence of Mastery:** For each plan the learner commits one of two bins. A placement is correct when it matches the Correct bin column in Content. Mastery is at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt. Reading the license table is exploration, not evidence. **Misconceptions:** (1) Any open license lets you publish a changed version. (2) NoDerivatives forbids all changes, including private ones. (3) A free license means you owe nothing in return. **Instructional Rationale:** Applying a license rule to a planned action is an Apply-level task that every improvement starts with. Eight plans that differ in license and in intended use teach the learner to read both parts before deciding. **Content:** The two bins: Allowed as planned, and Not allowed as planned. The license table, available on demand: CC0 allows publishing a changed version with nothing required. CC BY allows it with credit, a link to the license, and a note that changes were made. CC BY-SA adds that the new version must carry CC BY-SA. CC BY-NC allows it without commercial use. CC BY-ND does not allow sharing a changed version, and allows private changes. A resource with no license and all rights reserved allows nothing without the owner's permission. The eight plans (all made up): | # | Plan | Correct bin | What the learner is told afterward | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | The original is CC BY. The plan is to add alt text and post the improved version free for anyone. | Allowed as planned | Credit the author, link the license, and say that you changed the work. | | 2 | The original is CC BY-SA. The plan is to split it into modules and post them free for anyone. | Allowed as planned | Credit the author, link the license, say that you changed the work, and release the modules under CC BY-SA. | | 3 | The original is CC BY-ND. The plan is to rewrite it for a lower reading level and post the rewrite free. | Not allowed as planned | NoDerivatives does not allow sharing a changed version. Ask the owner, or keep the rewrite private. | | 4 | The original is CC BY-NC. The plan is to improve it and sell it in a paid course. | Not allowed as planned | NonCommercial does not allow selling it. Ask the owner for permission. | | 5 | The original is CC BY-NC. The plan is to improve it and post it free for other teachers. | Allowed as planned | Credit the author, link the license, say that you changed the work, and do not use it commercially. | | 6 | The original has no license and says all rights reserved. The plan is to fix its links and post the fixed version. | Not allowed as planned | No permission has been given. Ask the owner first. | | 7 | The original is CC0. The plan is to improve and publish it with no credit line. | Allowed as planned | Nothing is required, and giving credit is good practice. | | 8 | The original is CC BY-ND. The plan is to improve a copy for the learner's own use and share it with no one. | Allowed as planned | NoDerivatives allows private changes that are not shared. | **Provenance:** The plans are illustrative examples written for this chapter, and the sim labels them "illustrative examples". The license rules follow Chapter 2 and the chapter section "Derivative Work". The sim adds the note "check the legal text of your license". **Rules:** Each plan has exactly one correct bin. Five plans are Allowed as planned and three are Not allowed as planned. **Learner Activity:** 1. The learner sees one plan and may open the license table. Opening it does not change the score. 2. The learner places the plan in a bin, and the placement is committed. 3. The sim shows whether it was correct and the text in the last column of the table. 4. After plan 8 the sim shows the summary. **Feedback:** 8 plans in a shuffled order, one attempt each. Correct: "Correct: [bin]. [afterward text]". Incorrect: "Not quite. This plan is [bin]. [afterward text]". The summary shows "[n] of 8 correct on the first attempt". At 7 or more it adds "You can check a license before you edit." Below 7 it lists the afterward text of each missed plan. **Starting State:** The first plan in the shuffled order and the two bins. The question shown is "May you do this with the original?" **Chapter Anchors:** The chapter's license table lists the same seven cases. The sim adds the private-copy case for NoDerivatives and the free-versus-paid case for NonCommercial.
